TAL_BARRAGE_MARTIAL_FOCUS.why: Barrage uses the core Martial Focus pool: one at a time, spent as a cost (no Action), not spendable when absent, regained only up to one.

TAL_BARRAGE_MIXED_BARRAGE.why: Barrage: <weapon> + Mixed Barrage, then one Bonus Action melee weapon attack, Unarmed Strike or Shove instead of the ranged follow-up (combat/ext/barrage_blitz.py, rider lane C10).

TAL_BARRAGE_SPINNING_SHOT.why: Barrage: <weapon> + Spinning Shot (Martial Focus), then two Bonus Action attacks, each at a different creature (combat/ext/barrage_blitz.py, rider lane C10).

TAL_BARRAGE_VIGILANT_SHARPSHOOTER.why: Printed rider retained: needs a general opportunity seam supporting multiple wielded profiles and player weapon selection; the current hook is pure and single-profile.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MASS_TAME.why: Beast Tamer targets up to Proficiency Bonus hostile creatures within range, each saving separately (combat/ext/beastmastery_tamer.py, rider lane C10). Tamer capacity stays with the GM.

TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SLEEVE_BOWL_AND_BOOT.why: Printed rider retained: object possession and Drunken Style-only permission until turn end need separate representations; the general improvised condition overgrants.

TAL_IRON_FIST_MEDICINE_OF_THE_CLOSED_GAT.why: In combat: Medicine of the Closed Gate (Action, Martial Focus) -- a Wisdom (Medicine) check against DC 15 lets you or an ally within reach repeat one save against a bodily condition (combat/ext/iron_medicine.py, rider lane C10). The one-minute treatment is outside fights.

tianxia.talent.beauty.courtly_grace.why: The skill proficiency is a build choice; the two-skill Adorn the Moment benefit is already how the table's Adorn runs (Advantage on the next check with any of its listed skills).

tianxia.talent.beauty.shared_spotlight.why: Adorn the Moment + Shared Spotlight: the chosen option on you and one willing ally within 30 feet (combat/ext/beauty_adorn.py, rider lane C10).
